nodes.title: Prompt One
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: A young male anime swordsman named Ren with short black hair featuring sharp red front highlights, intense blue eyes, blood splatters across his left cheek, wearing a dark green patterned haori with golden-yellow geometric patterns over a black uniform, white leg wraps, and dark sandals, wielding a katana emitting a vibrant cyan-blue energy trail.
<Subject 2>: A tall demonic anime warrior named Kuro possessing long spiky black ponytail hair, two dark curved horns protruding from his forehead, pale greyish-white skin with crimson facial markings, sharp pointed ears, shredded black and crimson traditional robes exposing pale beast-like legs, wielding a curved katana glowing with bright red energy.

detailed_description:
Timeline:
[00.000s-01.592s]:
[VISUAL]: In a traditional Japanese courtyard at night, <Subject 1> unsheathes a glowing blue katana and charges forward at high speed. <Subject 2> rushes toward him with a red blade, clashing swords with bright energy sparks in a rapid dynamic exchange.
[SOUNDS]: Metallic sword draw, rushing footsteps, sharp blade clash with surging energy sparks.

[01.592s-03.183s]:
[VISUAL]: <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> lock blades in close combat, pushing forcefully against each other before <Subject 2> swings a fiery red arc that forces <Subject 1> to dodge backward across the stone pavement.
[SPEECH]: <Subject 2> (S1) <d>[Japanese] "Hya!"</d>
[SOUNDS]: Steel scraping, whoosh of fiery sword swing, foot skidding on stone.

[03.183s-04.775s]:
[VISUAL]: <Subject 1> drops low into a sliding crouch, surging forward with yellow speed trails to evade <Subject 2>'s slash, then springs up to deliver a heavy spin kick into the chest of <Subject 2>.
[SPEECH]: <Subject 1> (S2) <d>[Japanese] "Ha!"</d>
[SOUNDS]: Fast sliding swoosh, sharp air rush, heavy blunt impact thump against chest.

[04.775s-06.380s]:
[VISUAL]: <Subject 2> is blasted backward through the air and crashes hard onto the courtyard ground. As <Subject 2> struggles up with his red blade, <Subject 1> sprints aggressively forward to close the distance.
[SOUNDS]: Body crashing onto ground, scattered debris, rapid running footsteps.

[06.380s-08.000s]:
[VISUAL]: [Shot 1] Extreme close-up of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> locking glowing blades face-to-face, sparks erupting between them. <Subject 1> punches forward with a sudden burst of energy, hitting <Subject 2> and sending blood spraying.
[SOUNDS]: Loud metallic blade screech, heavy flesh punch impact, demonic grunt.

summary:
A high-intensity anime-style sword fight in a moonlit traditional Japanese temple courtyard under the full moon, where a determined demon hunter clashes swords, and battles a powerful horned demon warrior in stylized, dynamic modern 2D/3D anime cinematic visual style.

overall_soundscape:
Fast-paced combat audio with sharp steel clashes, blazing energy whooshes, gritty impacts, sliding footsteps on stone pavers, and night courtyard ambiance.

non_diegetic_music:
Fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping orchestral anime battle music featuring pounding taiko drums, rapid string ostinatos, and dramatic brass swells driving the rapid tempo of combat.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:

detailed_description:
Timeline:
[00.000s-01.620s]:
[VISUAL]: [Shot 6] Overhead high-angle view showing <Subject 2> completing a wide flaming spin attack around <Subject 1> over the fractured courtyard paving.
[SOUNDS]: Heavy swirling fire roar, foot slide on pavement.

[01.620s-02.900s]:
[VISUAL]: The camera pulls into a dynamic high-angle overhead view as <Subject 2> swings a massive fiery crimson-and-black crescent slash sweeping through the air, carving a smoking trail across the stone path. <Subject 1> ducks rapidly under the flaming arc, coats his body in a yellow dash aura, and propels himself forward in an instant burst, delivering a heavy downward sliding kick directly into the midsection of <Subject 2> to force him backwards.
[SOUNDS]: Whooshing infernal flame slash, rapid rushing wind of high-speed dash, solid thudding body impact on robes.

[02.900s-04.350s]:
[VISUAL]: The camera orbits down near stone lantern height as <Subject 2> skids backward across the courtyard, digging his beast-like feet into the ground near a glowing wooden lantern. <Subject 1> crouches low in a combat stance with blue blade held ready, then blurs forward in a split-second flash-step, vanishing in a yellow motion trail before reappearing in a tight low-angle close-up charging furiously past the camera.
[SPEECH]: <Subject 1> (S1) <d>[Japanese] "Hyaaa!"</d>
[SOUNDS]: Fast sliding footstep on stone, wooden lantern creaking, deep charging battle yell, instantaneous high-speed rush burst.

[04.350s-05.800s]:
[VISUAL]: Low-angle tracking shot at ground level under a bright full moon as <Subject 1> charges across the bloodstained cobblestone pathway toward <Subject 2>. <Subject 2> slashes downward with his glowing red sword, but <Subject 1> thrusts his cyan-glowing katana forward at blinding speed, stabbing straight through the chest of <Subject 2> with a blinding burst of golden-white impact sparks and dispersed energy shockwaves.
[SOUNDS]: Fast sprinting strides, sharp steel cutting through air, high-energy piercing blast impact with sizzling electrical sparks.

[05.800s-07.250s]:
[VISUAL]: The camera circles tightly around the combatants as <Subject 2> roars in pain, drops to one knee onto the blood-splattered stone tiles, and sweeps his red katana around defensively in a glowing arc. <Subject 1> swiftly steps back into a stable two-handed sword stance, holding his glowing blue katana angled upward, breathing heavily while locking eyes with the kneeling demon in the moonlit courtyard.
[SOUNDS]: Demon snarling roar of agony, crimson blade slicing through atmosphere, heavy knee dropping onto cobblestone, tense sharp breathing.

[07.250s-08.000s]:
[VISUAL]: The camera holds a low-angle medium shot beneath the illuminated torii gate and night sky as <Subject 1> grips his glowing blue katana firmly, ready for the next clash while <Subject 2> clutches his wound on the ground.
[SOUNDS]: Subtle low wind rustle across temple courtyard, residual humming of mystical blade energies.
